title: Effective date.
bodyText:
PART 4. EFFECTIVE DATE

This article shall take effect on June 29, 2023.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "June 29, 2023" substituted for "the effective date of this Act" pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
PART 4.  EFFECTIVE DATE

 

     [§490:13-401]  Effective date.  This article shall take effect on June 29, 2023. [L 2023, c 132, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "June 29, 2023" substituted for "the effective date of this Act" pursuant to §23G-15.
